WITH per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER') as order_ref, 
    AVG(COALESCE(fillcount, 0)) as avg_fillcount 
  FROM orderexecutions 
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER')
),
first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as first_bench_val 
  FROM per_order_avg
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT 
    poa.avg_fillcount,
    (poa.avg_fillcount - fb.first_bench_val) as first_excess
  FROM per_order_avg poa 
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark fb 
  WHERE poa.avg_fillcount > fb.first_bench_val
),
second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as second_bench_val 
  FROM above_first
),
above_second AS (
  SELECT 
    af.avg_fillcount,
    af.first_excess,
    (af.avg_fillcount - sb.second_bench_val) as second_excess
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb
  WHERE af.avg_fillcount > sb.second_bench_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_fill_qty,
  AVG(first_excess) as avg_first_excess,
  AVG(second_excess) as avg_second_excess
FROM above_second
